column1: # Written by tools/make_kana_decks.py. Change the program, not this file.
# The gloss is what to type. The note says how it sounds, or, for katakana that are
# taken for one another, how to tell them apart.

column7: note
a: マ ma with a leg down
i as in machine; same as い
u: a tick on top. ワ wa has none
e as in bed; same as え
o as in more; same as お
ka as in car; same as か
ki as in key; same as き
ku: no bar inside. ケ ke and タ ta have one
ke: the bar sticks out to the left
ko: open to the left. ユ yu has a long base
sa as in salsa; same as さ
shi: strokes rise from the left. ツ tsu falls
su: ends open. ヌ nu has a stroke across
se as in set; same as せ
so: the long stroke falls. ン n rises
ta: ク ku with a short stroke inside
chi: the top stroke slants. テ te is flat
tsu: strokes fall from the top. シ shi rises
te: two flat bars. チ chi slants on top
to as in tall; same as と
na as in nacho; same as な
ni as in knee; same as に
nu: ス su with a stroke across
ne as in net; same as ね
no: one stroke. ソ so and ン n have two
ha as in harp; same as は
hi as in he; same as ひ
fu: one corner only. ワ wa has a left side
he as in hen; same as へ
ho as in horn; same as ほ
ma: the dot is inside. ム mu stands on a base
mi as in me; same as み
mu: a base line with a dot. マ ma is a corner
me as in met; same as め
mo as in more; same as も
ya as in yard; same as や
yu: the base is longer than the top
yo: three bars. コ ko has two
ra: a light tap, between r, l and d; same as ら
ri: a light tap, as in the tt of city; same as り
ru: a light tap; same as る
re: a light tap; same as れ
ro: a light tap; same as ろ
wa: flat on top. ウ u has a tick
o, rare; typed wo; same as を
n: the long stroke rises. ソ so falls
